definition: The target appears or increases as a product of the mechanism.
direction_rule: allowed_directions contains INCREASE; it also contains DECREASE only when the target later declines (trajectory_shape PEAK_THEN_DECLINE) or the direction depends on conditions, and then evidence must say so.
caution: Products can peak and decline (SSOT 144.1 frozen caution; 210.17). A marker that is formed is not thereby a unique identifier of the mechanism.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 210.16-210.17

definition: The target decreases by breakdown; the products are not specified.
caution: A fitted loss can hide several mechanisms (leaching, volatilisation, degradation: SSOT 210.20-210.22); destruction is not leaching.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 144.2

definition: The target is used up as a named reactant or substrate of the mechanism.
caution: Substrate availability is a precondition (state), not an effect.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725

definition: The target is converted by oxidation. Whether its amount rises or falls depends on whether the target is the oxidised product or the substrate: say which with target_role.
direction_rule: Follows target_role (schema field): SUBSTRATE: DECREASE only (or [UNKNOWN]); PRODUCT: allowed_directions must contain INCREASE (or be [UNKNOWN]); UNKNOWN role: no fixed direction. State analyte_form so the direction is interpretable.
caution: Analyte form matters (reduced form vs reduced plus oxidised form): state it, do not infer it.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725

definition: The target is converted by reduction (see OXIDIZED for the target_role rule).
direction_rule: Follows target_role (schema field): SUBSTRATE: DECREASE only (or [UNKNOWN]); PRODUCT: allowed_directions must contain INCREASE (or be [UNKNOWN]); UNKNOWN role: no fixed direction. State analyte_form so the direction is interpretable.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725

definition: The target is converted to an isomer.
caution: State which isomer the target names.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725

definition: The target moves from the food to the cooking liquid (a transfer, not a loss from the system).
direction_rule: compartment TISSUE: DECREASE only. compartment COOKING_MEDIUM: INCREASE only. compartment WHOLE_SYSTEM is not admitted (a transfer conserves the whole system).
caution: Leaching vs destruction must stay distinguishable in boiling (SSOT 144.2; 210.21).
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 144.2; 210.21

definition: The target moves to the gas phase or headspace (including water leaving as vapour: the moisture-loss mechanism).
direction_rule: compartment TISSUE: DECREASE only. compartment COOKING_MEDIUM: no direction rule (SSOT 210.22 names no receiving compartment; a gas phase or headspace is not a compartment value). compartment WHOLE_SYSTEM: DECREASE only (loss from the system).
caution: Whether drip or exudate loss is LEACHED, VOLATILIZED or neither is an open H4 question.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 210.22

definition: A protein-type target loses native structure (collagen denaturation is named in SSOT 144.1).
direction_rule: No fixed direction on the target; typically a structural state or an observable.
caution: No universal temperature switch (SSOT 144.1 frozen caution).
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 144.1

definition: Molecules associate into larger structures (protein aggregation, gelation).
caution: Gelation is named in SSOT 144.1 together with aggregation.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 144.1

caution: Water-limited and heating-rate dependent in the literature; no universal temperature switch.
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 144.1

definition: The target is changed by microbial fermentation.
caution: Microbial kinetics follow substrate / biomass formulations (SSOT 210.26).
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725; SSOT 210.26

definition: A change is expected but its species, form or direction is not known. Also the honest effect type for an observable (colour, browning) whose mechanism species are not asserted.
direction_rule: allowed_directions may be [UNKNOWN] or a known direction of the observable.
caution: Use it instead of inventing a species (MP W6: never manufacture a balanced reaction).
source: ledgers/schemas/RXN.schema.json relation enum; MP W6 L1689-1725

definition: The target moves into the food from the medium (oil uptake, water or moisture uptake).
direction_rule: compartment TISSUE: INCREASE only. compartment COOKING_MEDIUM: DECREASE only. compartment WHOLE_SYSTEM is not admitted (an uptake conserves the whole system).
caution: RXN has no inward-transfer verb (LEACHED and VOLATILIZED are outward). Adding it needs H4 (additive).
source: plan Step 21 card 21b (oil uptake); PROC mechanism label oil_uptake

definition: Matrix structure or texture changes without a specified chemistry (cell-wall softening, collagen solubilisation).
direction_rule: No fixed direction; direction is that of the observable (e.g. a texture or force measure).
caution: Keeps texture-level mechanisms from being forced into a chemical verb. Adding it needs H4 (additive).
source: SSOT 144.1 (pigment / cell-wall transitions); PROC mechanism label cell_wall_softening

definition: The mechanism sets a non-analyte state (cell integrity, enzyme activity state) that later mechanisms need.
direction_rule: No direction semantics: the target is a categorical history state (names owned by 16a).
caution: May belong to Step-18 deterministic operators instead of MECH (open H4 question). Never an analyte effect.
